Quick infra notes from my side (prep checklist):

- We'll provision a scoped API key that expires 24 hours after issuance. Key will be limited to staging cluster only.
- Please use Authorization: Bearer <key> for the test; if you want mTLS we can coordinate but it adds lead time.
- Recommended request headers: X-Request-ID (uuid v4), X-ACME-Trace (optional customer trace id).
- Rate limiting: we'll not enforce hard throttles for the agreed window but will return 429s if connection saturation occurs. If you see >5% 5xx or consistent 429 we recommend pausing the run and we'll snapshot logs.
- Stream tuning: I'll temporarily increase streaming buffer window and max concurrent streams on the staging host for the 3-hour window.
- Monitoring: CS/Eng will watch p50/p95/p99 latency, token-generation throughput, CPU and GPU utilization, and active connections. We'll publish a simple dashboard link before the run.
